blurb: Adagio Dance Academy offers dance classes for all ages starting from toddlers to adults, including recreational and competitive levels. Classes cover multiple dance styles such as Ballet, Tap, Jazz, Hip Hop, Lyrical, Contemporary, Acro, and Musical Theatre. They also offer summer camps, pop-up camps, and private lessons.
